medicalDisclaimer.title: Not Medical Advice
medicalDisclaimer.content: La Piña is an educational and wellness tracking tool. It is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition.
urgentCareGuidance: Unusually heavy bleeding (soaking through a pad in less than 1 hour)
Signs of infection (fever over 100.4°F, foul-smelling discharge)
Sudden severe headache or vision changes
Signs of ectopic pregnancy or miscarriage
Severe mood changes or thoughts of self-harm

dataRetention.localData: Stored on device indefinitely until user deletes
dataRetention.cloudBackup: Optional; deleted within 30 days of account deletion
dataRetention.analytics: Minimal; aggregated and anonymized; retained for 90 days

gdpr: Right to erasure (right to be forgotten)
ccpa: Right to know what personal information is collected
Right to know if personal information is sold or disclosed
Right to say no to the sale of personal information
Right to access your personal information
Right to equal service and price
